pseudos.text: The medical entrance exam cancellation became the grand finale of a circus nobody bought tickets to. A jester who rang the bell from Sikar delivered leaked PDFs matching the chemistry paper, forcing the testing authority to admit the whole assessment was a bust.

Thirteen people arrested, including the coaching figure who once championed student justice, became the punchline of India's NEET-UG scandal. The coaching figure, now caught in the web, saw the investigation agency swing into law enforcement action after a tip-off from Sikar exposed the farce.

The rescheduled examination for June 21 became the encore performance nobody requested. After the examination event unraveled, the government agency referred the paper-setting staff to the national investigative agency, leading to arrests and this planned re-examination consequence.
